findings.location: Proof, step 2.1, application of [L3] to the associated first-order system
findings.evidence: [L3] requires hM ≤ r and Λh < 1. Step 2.1 chooses h,r only so the compact cylinder lies in D, obtains finite M and a state-Lipschitz constant, then applies [L3] without verifying these inequalities or shrinking h. Fixing a larger compact cylinder and its bounds, then choosing a smaller time width while retaining those bounds, closes the omission.
